config.no_folder: No folder for config.toml was found
feature.analyse.a1: Yes. Analyse works on any Game, whether you played it or opened it from a database.
feature.analyse.a2: Not while a rated game against a person is live online. It comes back when the game ends.
feature.analyse.q1: Can I analyse a game I did not play in Bragd?
feature.analyse.title: Analyse
feature.analyse.what: Step through a Game, try other moves, and let an Engine evaluate each position.
feature.databases.a1: No. Bragd reads a Foreign database in place, and only rewrites it when you choose Save.
feature.databases.a2: Two Games with the same moves from the same start are one Game in a Library, whatever their headers say. It remembers every Source it came from.
feature.databases.q1: Does opening a PGN file change it?
feature.databases.title: Databases
feature.databases.what: Open game files in their own formats, or import them into a Library where each Game appears once.
feature.disk.a1: Only when you turn that on for a Source. Otherwise Disk watch only warns you.
feature.disk.a2: A filter on the Games a Source's Route keeps, such as a minimum rating or a time control. Each Route pairs one with a Library, and a Game no Route keeps is never stored.
feature.disk.q1: Does Bragd delete anything by itself?
feature.disk.title: Disk watch
feature.disk.what: Shows what Bragd keeps on disk, warns at the limits you set, and can strip downloads to the Games you want.
feature.engines.a1: Bragd uses an installed Engine first. Otherwise it can pull a sealed container image with podman or docker.
feature.engines.a2: Tafl, ur and senet have no outside Engine. They get Bragd's own built-in Bots.
feature.engines.q1: Do I have to install Stockfish?
feature.engines.q2: Why is there no Engine for tafl?
feature.engines.title: Engines
feature.engines.what: Programs that play and evaluate positions, found on this machine or run from a sealed container image.
feature.families.a1: Settings → Game families, or the install wizard. Each Family and each Variant has its own switch.
feature.families.a2: Nothing is deleted. Its files still open, with a banner offering to turn it back on.
feature.families.q1: Where do I turn a game off?
feature.families.q2: What happens to my games of a Family I turn off?
feature.families.title: Game families
feature.families.what: Chess, xiangqi, shogi, go, draughts, tafl, backgammon, ur and senet, with 25 Variants. Turn off what you do not play.
feature.helper.a1: It fetches Sources, indexes your Libraries and finds Duplicates, so the windows stay quick.
feature.helper.a2: Ten minutes after the last window closes, unless Start with my session is on.
feature.helper.title: The Helper
feature.helper.what: A background process shared by every Bragd window that fetches, indexes and finds Duplicates.
feature.play.a1: Yes: play against an Engine, against yourself on one board, or online.
feature.play.a2: Each Variant names its own Sides: White and Black, Red and Black, Sente and Gote, Attackers and Defenders.
feature.play.q1: Can I play both Sides myself?
feature.play.q2: Why are the Sides not called White and Black?
feature.play.title: Play
feature.play.what: Start a Game of any Variant that is on, against an Engine, against yourself or online.
feature.tablebases.a1: 3–5 pieces, about 1 GB, covers most endgames. 6 pieces is a large download; 7 pieces is a folder you bring yourself.
feature.tablebases.a2: Only when the tables you have do not cover a position, and only while Ask Lichess for tablebase positions is on.
feature.tablebases.q2: When does a position go to Lichess?
feature.tablebases.title: Tablebases
feature.tablebases.what: Perfect play for chess positions with few pieces, from Syzygy tables, passed to every engine.
feature.themes.a1: Racing green, Bragd's own, built on the colours of its icon.
feature.themes.a2: No. A Board theme never inverts with a dark Theme: the light squares stay the lighter ones.
feature.themes.q2: Does a dark Theme turn the board dark?
feature.themes.title: Temas
feature.themes.what: Thirty built-in Themes, a Look laid over them, your own Themes in config.toml, and four Board themes.
feature.update.a1: No. Solo te avisa. La actualización queda en manos de la forma en que lo instalaste, así que tu gestor de paquetes sigue a cargo.
feature.update.a2: Untick Check for a new version in Settings → Privacy and updates.
feature.update.q2: How do I turn the check off?
feature.update.title: Búsqueda de actualizaciones
feature.update.what: At start and once a day, asks where Bragd was installed from whether a newer release exists, and names the command that upgrades your copy.
feature.wizard.a1: Yes: Settings → Overview → Run the install wizard again.
feature.wizard.a2: What's new in the sidebar lists every version with its cards.
feature.wizard.q1: Can I run the wizard again?
feature.wizard.q2: Where do I see what came in a version?
feature.wizard.title: Install wizard and What's new
feature.wizard.what: On the first start, six short steps set up Bragd. After an upgrade, cards show what is new.
features.title: Funciones y preguntas
help.title: Ayuda
hint.features: F1 lists every feature, with the questions people ask about it.
hint.sidebar: Click a Game family to see its items. The arrow at the bottom folds the sidebar away.
hint.wizard: Settings → Overview runs the install wizard again.
notice.config_refused: config.toml, [{area}]: {problem}. Those settings keep their defaults until it is mended.
notice.config_unreadable: config.toml could not be read: {problem}. Every setting keeps its default until it is mended.
notice.disk_fetch_paused: {source} is not fetched while the disk is over your limits.
notice.disk_free_low: Only {free} is free on the disk that holds {path}, below your threshold of {limit}.
notice.disk_total_over: Bragd keeps {size} on disk, over your limit of {limit}.
notice.family_off: {family} is turned off. Its files still open, and none of its data is deleted.
notice.source_out_of_scope: {source} is listed so you know it is coming, but this version of Bragd cannot fetch it yet.
setting.board_theme.hint: The four colours of every board: light square, dark square, highlight and marker. Match theme takes them from the Theme.
setting.check_updates.hint: When it starts, then once a day while it is open, Bragd asks where it was installed from for the newest version number. Nothing else is sent.
setting.engines_containers: Pull an Engine that is not installed
setting.engines_containers.hint: Runs it from a sealed container image with podman or docker, with no network. An image shows its size before it downloads.
setting.language.hint: Automatic follows your system's language, or the nearest one Bragd has.
setting.library.hint: Where your Libraries are kept. Empty: Bragd's data folder.
setting.look.hint: The shapes and chrome laid over the Theme's colours. Empty: the Theme's own.
setting.source_priority.hint: When Duplicates merge, a header conflict goes the way of the Source listed first.
setting.start_with_session.hint: The Helper keeps fetching and indexing while no window is open. Otherwise it stops ten minutes after the last window closes.
setting.tablebases_online.hint: When your tables do not cover a position, that position is sent to the Lichess tablebase API.
setting.tablebases_path.hint: Your Syzygy tables. The folder is passed to every engine.
setting.theme.hint: The app's colours, and with some Themes their own shapes. Racing green is the default.
settings.suggest_translation_hint: Abre en el navegador un issue nuevo en GitHub, con el idioma y la versión ya completados. Bragd no envía nada por su cuenta.
settings.suggest_which: The text to mend, as it shows (optional)
settings.title: Configuración
tour.databases.text: Open PGN, SGF, KIF, PDN and more where they are, or import them into a Library without duplicates.
tour.databases.title: Databases and Libraries
tour.disk.text: See what Bragd keeps on disk, set limits, and strip big downloads to the Games you want.
tour.disk.title: Disk watch
tour.engines.text: Stockfish, KataGo, Pikafish and the others: installed ones first, sealed container images otherwise. Analyse lets them evaluate every position.
tour.engines.title: Engines and Analyse
tour.families.text: Nine Game families and 25 Variants, each playable against yourself. Turn off what you do not play in Settings → Game families.
tour.families.title: Every Game family, ready to play
tour.helper.text: One background process fetches Sources such as TWIC on a schedule, indexes and finds Duplicates for every window.
tour.helper.title: The Helper and Sources
tour.themes.text: Racing green and 29 other Themes, and four Board themes, in Settings → Look.
tour.themes.title: Themes and Board themes
update.download: Download it from the releases page.
update.lags: {channel} may not have it for a few days yet.
whats_new.title: Novedades
wizard.big: Large: {size} for each fetch. Make sure the disk has room, and set a Strip rule to keep only the Games you want.
wizard.engines: Engines Bragd found on this machine, for each Game family that is on. Tafl, ur and senet get Bragd's own Bots.
wizard.engines_none: No Game family that is on uses an outside Engine.
wizard.families: Turn off what you do not play: it leaves the sidebar, New game and engine setup. Its files still open, and nothing is deleted.
wizard.helper: The Helper fetches Sources and keeps your Libraries in order in the background, for every Bragd window.
wizard.image_ready: A sealed image can be pulled with podman or docker.
wizard.image_unpublished: No sealed image is published yet.
wizard.knowledge: Downloads that make Bragd more useful. Each shows its size first. Nothing downloads until you press Done on the last step.
wizard.later: You can change this later in Settings → {area}.
wizard.no_room: These downloads need {size}, and only {free} is free. Keep at least {spare} spare: choose less, or free some space first.
wizard.online: Signing in to play on Lichess, Lishogi, pychess.org and OGS comes in a later version of Bragd. Until then, play there in your browser.
wizard.title: {step} ({n} of {of})
wizard.welcome: Choose your language, Theme and Board theme. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.will_fetch: {name} is turned on and fetched on its schedule: about {size} each time.
page.later: This part of Bragd comes in a later version.
play.scoring: Click the stones you both agree are dead, then propose them. Accept counts the score; Resume goes back to play.
settings.overview: Bragd {version}. {families} Game families and {variants} Variants are on.
db.bad_position: That is not a position Bragd can read
db.capped: Only the first {games} Games are listed: the file is larger than Bragd lists at once.
db.downloaded: This file was downloaded. Bragd reads it in place; writing over it is allowed but discouraged, because the next fetch may replace it.
db.no_board: This Game's moves are listed without a board for now.
db.none_hint: Open a PGN, SCID, ChessBase, SGF, KIF, CSA or PDN file. Bragd reads it where it is and changes nothing in it.
db.overwrite: {path} was downloaded. Writing over it is discouraged: the next fetch may replace it, and its Games in the Library still name it. Write over it anyway?
db.read_error: The file could not be read to its end: {why}
db.unplayable: The moves stop at {move}, which cannot be played.
disk.auto_hint: When a limit a Source counts against is crossed. All of these are off until you turn them on.
disk.auto_title: What Disk watch may do by itself
disk.bad_size: {text} is not a size: type it as 500 MB or 5 GB
disk.external_hint: A folder you chose outside Bragd's data folder: shown, counted in no total, never touched.
disk.free_below: Warn when free space falls below
disk.intro: What Bragd keeps on disk, and the limits Disk watch holds it to. A crossed limit gives a notice; nothing is deleted unless you turn that on for a Source below.
disk.prune_hint: Removes the Games every one of whose Sources' Routes to this Library strips them. Preview first: it counts what would go and changes nothing.
disk.saved: Limits saved. The next check uses them.
disk.size_hint: Type sizes such as 500 MB or 5 GB; leave empty for no limit.
disk.title: Disk use
helper.lost: The line to the Helper broke
helper.odd_reply: The Helper gave an answer this window does not expect
helper.title: Helper
helper.unreachable: The Helper could not be reached: {why}
job.report_files: Downloads: {files} files, {kept} Games kept and {stripped} stripped, {before} to {after}.
job.report_library: Library: {games} of {of} Games go, giving back {bytes}.
jobs.title: Jobs
lib.dedupe_hint: Merges the headers of every Game with several Sources again, by the Source priority below.
lib.name: Library
lib.near_hint: A Game whose moves are the start of another's. Bragd never merges these on its own: open both and decide.
lib.none: No Library yet. Import a file, or turn on a Source, and its Games land in main.bragd.
priority.hint: When Duplicates disagree on a header, the Source higher up wins. Drag to reorder. Saving restarts the Helper, which picks up the new order; Dedupe now applies it to the Games already merged.
priority.saved: Source priority saved; the Helper restarts to use it.
priority.title: Source priority
replay.evp: Evaluation profile: White's advantage up, Black's down
replay.keys: ← and → step through the moves; Home and End go to the start and the end.
setting.disk_free_below: Warn below this much free space, in bytes
setting.disk_free_below.hint: 0 is no warning. Set it on the Disk use page.
setting.disk_total: Disk limit for all Bragd keeps, in bytes
setting.disk_total.hint: 0 is no limit. Set it, and each item's own, on the Disk use page.
slice.keep_hint: Copies its Games into a Library of their own beside this one, to edit apart.
slice.name: Name
slice.players_hint: Part of a name; several apart by commas
slice.position_hint: Step through a Game in replay first: its board position is the one used.
slice.saved: Slice {name} saved. It is live: it shows the Library as it is now.
source.add_hint: A PGN, SGF, KIF, CSA or PDN file on the web, or a zip of them. It is downloaded again in full on each fetch.
source.after_import.strip: Keep only what the Strip rule keeps
source.intro: Every Source is off until you turn it on. Its size is shown before it downloads anything.
source.only_unmetered: Only on a connection that is not metered
source.paused: Not fetched while the disk is over your limits.
strip.apply_hint: Removes what the Routes' rules strip from this Source's downloads and from each Route's Library. Games another Source brought stay.
strip.hint: Which Games this Route keeps: as they arrive, and with Apply also those stored already. Every part you fill in must agree; a part left empty keeps everything.
strip.players_hint: Names as the Source writes them, apart by commas
strip.preview_hint: Counts what would go from the downloads and the Routes' Libraries, and the space it gives back. Nothing changes.
strip.title: Strip rule
tour.analyse.text: Step through any Game and let an Engine evaluate each position.
tour.analyse.title: Analyse a Game
tour.play.text: Play any Variant against an Engine or yourself.
tour.play.title: Play
tour.tablebases.text: Syzygy tables give perfect play with few pieces left, and every engine uses them.
tour.tablebases.title: Tablebases
tour.update.text: Bragd tells you when a newer version is out and how your copy upgrades. Turn it off in Settings → Privacy and updates.
tour.update.title: Update checks
analyse.locked: Analysis is locked while a rated online game against a person is being played.
analyse.paste: Paste a position: FEN, SFEN, PDN or a go picture
analyse.review_backgammon: Backgammon games cannot be reviewed yet.
analyse.tablebase_local: Your tablebases cover this position, and the engine reads them.
analyse.tablebase_off: Your tablebases do not cover this position, and the online tablebase is off.
books.intro: Polyglot opening books (.bin). Their moves for the position show in Play and Analyse.
books.not_a_book: {path} is not a Polyglot opening book.
engines.add_hint: Bragd starts the program once to check that it speaks this family's protocol, and keeps its path in config.toml.
engines.gone: The program of {name} is no longer where it was.
engines.illegal: The engine answered {move}, which is not a legal move here.
engines.install_hint: Install {program} with your system's package manager, or download it from {site}.
engines.no_move: The engine has no move here.
engines.state.no_image: Not installed, and Bragd's image of it is not yet published.
engines.state.no_runtime: Not installed, and neither podman nor docker is there to run its image.
engines.state.pull: Not installed. Its sealed image can be downloaded.
tablebase.cursed_win: {side} to move wins, but only after the 50-move rule
tablebase.blessed_loss: {side} to move loses, but saved by the 50-move rule
tablebases.about.Seven: 7 pieces, about 17 TB: download them yourself and choose their folder.
tablebases.folder_set: Your own folder. Bragd only reads it and downloads into it.
tablebases.intro: Syzygy tablebases: perfect play for chess positions with few pieces. Every engine is given the folder. Downloads come from tablebase.lichess.ovh.
tablebases.offline: Bragd is offline: nothing is downloaded or asked online.
tablebases.online: Ask the Lichess tablebase for positions your tables do not cover
tablebases.online_hint: Only the position is sent, and only while this is on.
tablebases.plan_first: Show the size first, then download.
source.too_big: The next download is {size}, more than this Source's limit of {cap}.
notice.download_too_big: {source}: the next download is {size}, more than its limit of {cap}. It waits until you say yes under Databases → Sources.
source.routes_hint: Each Route sends the Games its Strip rule keeps to one Library. The download is read once, and a Game goes to every Library whose Route keeps it, or nowhere when none does.
engines.network.absent: Its image needs its evaluation network, which Bragd does not ship: {size} to download, once you agree to its licence.
engines.network.failed: The network could not be downloaded: {why}
engines.network.title: {name}'s evaluation network
engines.network.intro: {name}'s image needs this network to play. It comes under its own licence, below, so Bragd does not ship it. If you agree, Bragd downloads {name}'s release ({size}), checks it, and keeps only the network, in Bragd's data folder. An installed {name} does not need it.
engines.network.missing: {name}'s image needs its evaluation network. Download it on the Engines page, under its licence.
engines.state.built: Runs from its image built on this machine.
engines.build_here: Its image is not published yet. Build it on this machine with {command}, then come back here.
